title: Never lose a buff
summary: Stack Your Buffs shows an icon for every buff you're missing or about to lose. One click casts it.

steps.say: Out in the world without Mark of the Wild: Stack Your Buffs puts up an icon for each buff you're missing.
Hover an icon to see what's wrong and what a click will do.
Left-click casts it. No digging through the spell book.
Thorns has about two minutes left, so its icon counts down. That's the early warning: quiet, no chat.
A minute before it runs out, the final warning plays a sound and says so in chat.
One click recasts it for another 10 minutes.
Every buff is up, so the bar is empty. It stays out of the way until something needs you.
